inputs.checklistItemText: Tree clearances measured from utility pole centerline or structure instead of from outer electric conductor
inputs.question: Are there any dimension lines, clearance measurements, or written notes on the landscape plan showing clearances from trees to the overhead electric (OHE) line along the southern boundary? If clearances are shown, what distances are noted?
inputs.regionHint: Along the southern property boundary where the OHE line is located and trees are positioned nearby

output.reasoning: The agent is asking whether clearance measurements exist and what they say (presence and readout of dimensions/notes), not asking to measure a clearance directly. This is a progressive verification step to identify whether clearance documentation is present on the plan before evaluating whether those measurements are taken from the correct reference point (conductor vs. pole centerline).
